before: Anonymous/caller-selected tenant reads, unscoped IDs and legacy tables.
after: Authenticated tenant boundary; transaction-local restricted role and forced RLS across tenant tables; FK ownership checks; tenant-keyed caches; timeline and fallback reads scoped. Signup membership is server-owned.
verification: Critical: anonymous, two tenants, raw SQL, direct IDs, overrides, signup, timeline/cache and foreign alert-rule writes. Browser: scoped inventory.

before: A second tenant overwrites the same canonical event identity.
after: Canonical IDs and uniqueness include tenant/environment; upserts cannot alter another tenant’s event.
verification: Critical: same source identity in two tenants, different IDs/content; foreign direct-ID 404.

before: Stored plan parameters change while approval accepts the old hash.
after: Canonical hashing binds version, tenant, action, target, parameters, preconditions, verification and rollback. DB payloads are immutable; approval/execution recompute and bind the approved hash. Diagnostic runbooks also validate stored content.
verification: Critical: parameter/target/action/version/provider/rollback tampering, immutable SQL update, required approval hash, execution guard before provider access; workflow E.

before: Emergency freeze is private memory and resets on restart.
after: Shared durable emergency state; policy, preflight and controllers await it; missing/unreadable state blocks guarded mutations.
verification: Critical: fresh-process persistence and fail-closed missing table; workflow E: two running processes observe the same freeze.

before: Concurrent workers can claim the same resource through process-local locking.
after: Tenant-scoped database active-claim/idempotency constraints and transactional advisory locking serialize lifecycle/remediation execution claims.
verification: Critical: simultaneous independent DB clients and cross-workflow claims produce one winner and one SQL 23505; no provider mutation.

before: OTLP bypasses canonical processing and does not update metrics, alerts or dependencies.
after: Key-owned tenant/environment feeds the shared transactional pipeline; canonical events, service metrics, alert evaluation and observed trace dependencies update together.
verification: Pipeline and workflow B: real HTTP metrics/logs/traces, fresh incident and timeline, parent/child dependency, duplicate replay and tenant attribution.

before: Masked keys reject legitimate ingestion; session middleware consumes OTLP bearer credentials.
after: Dedicated credential authentication decrypts and verifies enabled integration secrets, then establishes tenant scope. Header and bearer forms work; rotation invalidates old keys.
verification: Pipeline: missing/bad/foreign/disabled/rotated keys, valid bearer/custom header and malformed payload 400.

before: Provider 503 reports success/CONNECTED; disabled integrations synchronize.
after: Provider failures propagate as 502/ERROR with health evidence; disabled sync is 409 and sends no request; recovery updates success time.
verification: Correctness and workflow A: loopback 503, disable/re-enable, successful discovery/reconnect and lastSuccessAt.

before: A crashed symptom is score 88/CONFIRMED_FACT despite insufficient evidence; runtime input/mapping/persistence failures.
after: Crashes remain state evidence, not causal proof. Evidence-qualified hypotheses and consistent score breakdowns; malformed inputs and database timestamps handled; full-date deployment timing; tenant canonical log/span mapping; hypotheses saved before returning.
verification: Correctness: crash/cascade, malformed arrays, deterministic order and date boundaries. Workflow C: correct controlled service ranks first and is persisted. Labeled evaluation remains 85.7% top-1 / 100% top-3 / MRR .929.

before: One aggregate is multiplied into invented 1h/6h/24h burn rates.
after: Independent timestamped window counts; unknown windows remain null, including history; provenance and sample counts are persisted. Trace samples are explicitly incomplete coverage.
verification: Correctness: boundaries, independent rates, empty/null windows and persisted provenance; workflow F arithmetic.

before: Origin prefix matching accepts localhost:51730 for localhost:5173.
after: Exact parsed Origin/Referer matching with cookie-auth checks; dedicated credential ingestion retains its own authentication.
verification: Critical: cookie request with prefix origin and dummy Authorization is 403; legitimate browser actions succeed.

before: Role-only AWS credentials validate but roleArn is ignored.
after: Lazy STS temporary credentials receive role ARN, external ID, session name, region and optional source credentials; malformed IAM role is rejected.
verification: Pipeline: injected credential factory/client captures configuration without AWS requests. Real STS/account access remains NOT VERIFIED.

before: SSRF checks miss DNS, bracketed IPv6 and mapped addresses.
after: Normalize IP forms; resolve and validate all DNS answers through transport lookup; block metadata/link-local even under private opt-in; provider HTTP clients reject redirects.
verification: Pipeline: IPv4/IPv6/mapped/metadata and DNS-answer rejection; provider transport review. No metadata endpoint contacted.

before: A new process repeats processing side effects after Map deduplication is lost.
after: Durable integration/tenant/environment/provider/type observation claims share the canonical-processing transaction. Stable source IDs with later observation timestamps still process; exact replay does not.
verification: Pipeline: fresh-process replay, simultaneous HTTP ingestion by two backend processes, later observation/exact replay. Fixture cleanup now includes owned durable claims.

before: Expected self-approval, tampering, expiry and disabled execution are HTTP 500.
after: Domain denials map to meaningful 4xx; checks remain enforced. Database authorization/unique/unavailable errors map to 403/409/503.
verification: Workflow E: self-approval 403, hash tamper 409, expiry 409, disabled execution 403 and zero execution records.

before: Viewer/responder inventory is blank because bundled admin audit fetch rejects.
after: Cloud page requests audit data only for an admin; authorized inventory loads for each role.
verification: Browser: viewer and responder see fixture inventory and make zero admin-audit requests.

before: Tabs/account controls are clipped at 390px.
after: Shrinkable header controls, bounded cluster selector and wrapping/stacked integration tabs.
verification: Browser: actual account/tab bounds and clicks at 390px, fonts recorded, screenshot retained.

before: Typing an incomplete JSON object resets configuration to the previous object.
after: Keep raw configuration, credential and rotation drafts; parse only on submit and show validation feedback.
verification: Frontend feedback tests; browser: both partial drafts survive, invalid submit sends zero configuration requests, valid JSON paste remains editable.

before: Denied clipboard permission produces an uncaught rejection and false success.
after: Await/catch clipboard writes, keep success conditional and show recoverable failure. Shared handling covers postmortem export and onboarding command copy.
verification: Frontend: allowed/denied/missing API; browser: denied feedback/no rejection and successful 875-character Markdown copy.

before: An unchanged baseline produces namespace/region drift in addition to a state change.
after: Baseline and observed snapshot use the same canonical resource representation without double-normalizing an existing baseline.
verification: Correctness and workflow D: zero drift unchanged, exactly state after controlled change, preview only, zero non-GET provider requests.

before: Aggregate is FRESH/HIGH without service evidence; 25-hour-old data stays STALE/MEDIUM.
after: Entity-specific observation timestamps and coverage drive freshness/confidence; data older than 24h is unavailable/low. Sync time does not fabricate service telemetry.
verification: Correctness: no samples, entity coverage and >24h age; workflow F health endpoints.

before: Measured zero CPU/memory is replaced by a default.
after: Retain the original nullish-fallback fix and read provider metadata utilization without discarding measured zero.
verification: Existing backend zero/missing regressions plus correctness/workflow F: zero metadata produces estimated idle-compute insight.

before: Admin operational Sync Patterns/Scan Warnings is denied.
after: Retain corrected admin/responder route authorization while viewer writes stay denied.
verification: Existing HTTP role matrix plus browser: admin patterns sync and warning scan both 200.

before: Four stale suite assertions fail.
after: Update registry to eight providers, inject a real-contract Kubernetes fixture, assert AVAILABLE Prometheus status, and retain malformed OTLP rejection. Tenant-owned governance fixtures and durable-claim cleanup replace invalid assumptions.
verification: Safe suite selection: integration 15/15, failure recovery 20/20 and all selected suites pass; initial failures preserved.

before: Backend/DB failures present simulated services as successful data.
after: Tenant requests propagate failures; frontend core records start empty, clear on user change and display API failure. Investigation waits safely for initial data and never substitutes another incident. Aborted transactions cannot report success.
verification: Critical: injected DB refusal 503/no fake data and swallowed-SQL rollback rejection. Browser: controlled API 503, no seeded payment service, all 19 routes without runtime errors.

before: Monolithic entry is 1,737.64 kB and raises Vite warning.
after: Lazy route loading and vendor splitting; 500 kB per-JS-chunk regression budget. Comparable test-mode largest chunk 469.84 kB. Explicit production build: largest 262.55 kB, entry 82.96 kB; warning absent.
verification: Frontend build-budget tests, production package build and separate same-NODE_ENV comparison. Web Vitals remain NOT VERIFIED.

before: README says ten migrations/168 tests, names stale routes/scripts, and implies migration replay proves WAL recovery/RTO.
after: Document 22 migrations, actual startup/tests/nested routes, role/approval migration effects and safety flags. Distinguish logical row restore, internal crash recovery, and unverified archival-PITR/RPO/RTO.
verification: Documentation 3/3; fresh 22-migration/seed run; actual backend/frontend npm startup; Windows dump/restore matches 988 rows across 74 table hashes.
